items.caption:
Dream about being chased meaning: what science says.
In a survey of 1,181 students, being chased was the most common of 55 dream themes (81.5% at least once). One idea is threat rehearsal, still debated.

items.caption:
Millions have seen him at night.
In sleep paralysis you wake up unable to move, and many people see or sense an intruder. About 7.6% of people have had it at least once (Sharpless & Barber, 2011). Have you?
